main_text.l: ctrina, tanta inest tibi pietas, perlegi
volumen eruditione refertum, & elo-
quentiæ Gallicæ luminibus & Pigmentis
respersum atque illustratum omnibus,
paucos, veniam dabis amico candido,
& libertate Gallica tecum agenti, nævos
eximendos reperi, & adnotavi, pressi-
que, & premo me penes, mox in sinum
effusurus tuum, nam internos ex formu-
la fiduciæ cuncta geri, & inter bonos be-
ne agier oporteret: interim gratias ha-
beo ingentes pro indice Ecclesiasticarum
exercitationum ad Samaritanum Penta-
teuchum, qui tui in me benevoli animi
& ingenii in sacris historiis, librisque ver-
satissimi fidissimus, & certissimus index
est, mox relaturus pro ipsis Exercitatio-
nibus, quas Goezellus à te missus pollici-
tus est, eas ego jam legi apud eminentiss-
imum Cardinalem Mecœnatem meum,
& collaudavi uti decebat. Sed vidist
in[?] illud Tertuliani fragmentum cum Do-
nationis charta, quæ typis etiam Lute-
tiæ fuêre mandata? cum à me prius
Roma fuissent in lucem edita, tuam ego de[?]

page.notes: A printed brace stands in the right margin beside the line "Ecclesiasticarum" (lines 12–13); it is a mark, not text. The word "ctrina" at the head of the first line is cut at the page edge; its first letter is not clear, so it is given as printed with the fragment kept. The superscript mark after "in" in "vidist in" is unclear. The catchword is read as "ds", probably "de", and is uncertain.
